mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.5% in a monthly reading, it signals the start of a monetary tightening cycle, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS crosses above 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and the core CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening in response to high inflation, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is expected to maintain accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in monthly housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST has trended upward over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 in a monthly reading, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong retail sales (RSAFS > 600,000 million dollars), consumer spending is robust, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS > 600,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
